nodes.name: AI: Enrich Metadata
nodes.notes: Calls OpenRouter (free Mistral model) to generate SEO title, description, and tags. continueOnFail=true so upload still works if AI is unavailable.

nodes.name: AI: Parse & Fallback
nodes.notes: Parses the AI JSON response. If AI failed or returned invalid JSON, falls back to original title/description from the webhook payload.

parameters.name: post_info
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ title: $('Prepare Video Data').item.json.title, privacy_level: 'PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE', disable_duet: false, disable_comment: false, disable_stitch: false, video_cover_timestamp_ms: 1000 }) }}

nodes.name: TikTok Upload (HTTP)
nodes.notes: TikTok uses a 2-step upload. This initiates the upload. Add a second HTTP node to PUT the file to the upload_url returned here.

nodes.name: Instagram Reels (HTTP)
nodes.notes: Instagram Reels requires a public video URL. You need a file hosting step (e.g. upload to S3/Cloudflare R2) before this node.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $('Prepare Video Data').item.json.title + ' ' + $('Prepare Video Data').item.json.source_url }) }}

nodes.name: X / Twitter Post
nodes.notes: Twitter/X video upload requires the v1.1 chunked media upload API. This node posts a tweet with the source link. Replace with chunked upload flow for full video upload.

nodes.name: Dailymotion: Upload File
nodes.notes: Step 1 of 2 — uploads the video binary to Dailymotion's upload server. Returns a 'url' field used in step 2.

nodes.name: Dailymotion: Publish Video
nodes.notes: Step 2 of 2 — creates the video record on Dailymotion using the upload URL from step 1. Change 'channel' to your desired category (fun, music, tech, sport, etc.).

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  job_id:            $('AI: Parse & Fallback').item.json.job_id,
  destination_id:    $('AI: Parse & Fallback').item.json.destination_id,
  status:            $json.uploads && $json.uploads.youtube && $json.uploads.youtube.status === 'success' ? 'uploaded' : 'failed',
  platform:          'youtube',
  upload_url:        $json.uploads && $json.uploads.youtube ? ($json.uploads.youtube.url || '') : '',
  error_message:     $json.uploads && $json.uploads.youtube ? ($json.uploads.youtube.error || '') : '',
  ai_used:           !!$('AI: Parse & Fallback').item.json.ai_used,
  ai_title:          $('AI: Parse & Fallback').item.json.youtube_title,
  ai_description:    $('AI: Parse & Fallback').item.json.youtube_description,
  ai_tags:           $('AI: Parse & Fallback').item.json.youtube_tags
}) }}

nodes.name: Notify Dashboard
nodes.notes: POSTs the upload outcome to dashboard /api/callback so it appears in /history.
